def add_one(xs):
    """Add 1 to every number in the list."""
assert add_one([1, 2, 3]) == [2, 3, 4]
assert add_one([]) == []

def is_even(n):
    """Return True if n is even."""
assert is_even(4)
assert not is_even(7)

def count_zeros(xs):
    """Count how many items are zero."""
assert count_zeros([0, 1, 0]) == 2
assert count_zeros([5]) == 0

def first_char(s):
    """Return the first character of the string."""
assert first_char('hello') == 'h'
assert first_char('Zoo') == 'Z'

def sum_squares(xs):
    """Return the sum of the squares of the numbers."""
assert sum_squares([1, 2, 3]) == 14
assert sum_squares([]) == 0

def max_of_three(a, b, c):
    """Return the largest of three numbers."""
assert max_of_three(1, 5, 3) == 5
assert max_of_three(9, 2, 4) == 9

def abs_diff(a, b):
    """Return the absolute difference of a and b."""
assert abs_diff(3, 10) == 7
assert abs_diff(10, 3) == 7

def double_string(s):
    """Return the string repeated twice."""
assert double_string('ab') == 'abab'
assert double_string('') == ''

def drop_negatives(xs):
    """Remove the negative numbers from the list."""
assert drop_negatives([1, -2, 3]) == [1, 3]
assert drop_negatives([-1]) == []

def initials(name):
    """Return the initials of a full name in upper case."""
assert initials('ada lovelace') == 'AL'
assert initials('Alan Mathison Turing') == 'AMT'

def clamp(x, lo, hi):
    """Limit x to the range lo..hi."""
assert clamp(5, 0, 10) == 5
assert clamp(-3, 0, 10) == 0
assert clamp(42, 0, 10) == 10

def product(xs):
    """Return the product of the numbers in the list."""
assert product([2, 3, 4]) == 24
assert product([]) == 1

def is_sorted(xs):
    """Return True if the list is in ascending order."""
assert is_sorted([1, 2, 3])
assert not is_sorted([3, 1])

def count_char(s, c):
    """Count how many times the character c appears in s."""
assert count_char('banana', 'a') == 3
assert count_char('hello', 'z') == 0

def middle(xs):
    """Return the middle item of a list with an odd length."""
assert middle([1, 2, 3]) == 2
assert middle([7]) == 7

def ends_with_vowel(s):
    """Return True if the word ends with a vowel."""
assert ends_with_vowel('pizza')
assert not ends_with_vowel('cat')

def cube(x):
    """Return x cubed."""
assert cube(2) == 8
assert cube(3) == 27

def average(xs):
    """Return the mean of a non-empty list of numbers."""
assert average([1, 2, 3]) == 2
assert average([4]) == 4
